title: Bridge Cycloconverter Voltage Controller (Three-Phase)
text: 三相桥式周波变换器的 RMS 电压 PI 控制，输入 5 路、输出 2 路；{Rated voltage (phase-to-phase RMS)} 指定额定 RMS 电压、{Loop filter proportional gain} 指定 LF 比例增益、{Loop filter integral gain} 指定 LF 积分增益、{Filters time constant (s)} 指定时间常数 1e-2、{Controller proportional gain} 指定比例增益、{Controller integral gain} 指定积分增益、{Controller anti-windup gain} 指定抗积分饱和增益、{Thyristor pulse width (rad)} 指定脉冲宽度 5*pi/6、{Bank selector current threshold (A)} 指定电流阈值、{Pulse ordering} 指定脉冲排序规则 Sequential device、{Sample time (-1 for inherited)} 指定采样时间，按实例取值。

params.name: Rated voltage (phase-to-phase RMS)
params.values: 额定 RMS 电压 6000 (default) | positive number

params.name: Loop filter proportional gain
params.values: LF 比例增益 2 (default) | positive number

params.name: Loop filter integral gain
params.values: LF 积分增益 20 (default) | positive number

params.name: Controller anti-windup gain
params.values: 抗积分饱和增益 10 (default) | positive number

params.name: Pulse ordering
params.values: 脉冲排序规则 Sequential device order (default) | Natural order of commutation
